note: What a server sends to place a region on the ground: a patch that grants sight, blocks the way, or grows cover.

fields.name: team
fields.note: The side the region belongs to.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of region it is.

fields.name: owner
fields.note: The seat the region answers to. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The unit the region follows, or zero where it stands still.

fields.name: marker
fields.note: The unit standing in for the region itself, or zero where none does.

fields.name: sightFrom
fields.note: The unit whose sight the region grants, or zero.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where the region sits, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where it sits, along the other, in world units.

fields.name: lifetime
fields.note: How long it lasts, in seconds.

fields.name: collisionRadius
fields.note: How far out it blocks the way, in world units.

fields.name: grassRadius
fields.note: How far out it grows cover, in world units.

fields.name: sizeMultiplier
fields.note: What its stated radius is scaled by.

fields.name: sizeAdditive
fields.note: What is added to its stated radius after scaling, in world units.

bits.name: block
bits.note: Set where the region blocks the way. Set in everything observed.

bits.name: grantSight
bits.note: Set where it grants sight. Set in everything observed.

bits.name: revealHidden
bits.note: Set where it shows units that are hiding. Set in everything observed.

fields.name: baseRadius
fields.note: The radius the three size figures above are applied to, in world units.
